description: Build a before/after image comparison slider: upload two images (or use canvas placeholders), try the live demo, and copy the HTML + CSS + JS snippet.

faqs.a: Both images are read locally in your browser — nothing is uploaded to any server.
Yes — the generated snippet is self-contained with no dependencies and resizes with its container.
The slider uses a range input with keyboard support, so it is usable via keyboard and screen readers.

howto: Upload a "before" image and an "after" image.
Or press "Use canvas placeholders" to demo without uploads.
Drag the slider handle on the live demo.
Click "Copy snippet" and paste the HTML, CSS and JS into your page.
title: Before/After Image Comparison Slider Snippet
